name: com.open5500/open5500
title: Open5500
description: Form 5500 carriers, brokers, commissions and premiums for benefits brokers. Full results with a key.

tools.name: search_employers
tools.description: Find employers with Form 5500 health and welfare filings. All filters are optional and combine with AND. Returns up to 25 matches without a key (100 with one), largest first, with carriers, brokers, premium, comp rate, funding and renewal month. broker_of_record is the broker paid on medical or stop-loss contracts (null when none is); for self-funded employers medical_carriers is empty and insured_medical_carriers lists any insured carve-outs, since self-funded medical isn't on Schedule A. Union and multiple-employer plans are excluded unless include_union is true, and PEOs unless include_peo is true.

q.description: Words to match in employer name, DBA, current name, city, ZIP or EIN, or a website domain or address (acme.com)

funding.description: Medical funding, comma-separated: Fully insured, Self-funded (stop-loss), Self-funded, Mixed, Unknown, No medical reported. Partial words like 'self-funded' match both self-funded labels.

broker.description: Broker firm name (exact or partial), e.g. Lockton

carrier.description: Carrier name (exact or partial), e.g. Cigna

tpa.description: Third-party administrator from Schedule C (exact or partial), e.g. UMR, Meritain. Mostly self-funded plans with a trust.

has_line.description: Line of coverage the employer offers, e.g. Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, LTD, STD, Stop-Loss

missing_line.description: Line the employer does NOT have on Schedule A

industry.description: Industry sector, e.g. Manufacturing, Health care

employer_type.description: Employer type: Company, Nonprofit, School or university, Health system, Government, Church, Union or trust fund, Association or MEWA, PEO, Other (identified by an AI model from the name)

broker_changed.description: Only employers whose broker of record (the broker paid on medical or stop-loss contracts) changed in one of the two latest plan years

changed.description: Only employers with any of these recent changes vs their previous filing, comma-separated: broker, carrier (main medical carrier), funding (fully insured <-> self-funded), headcount (participants up or down 25%+ and 100+), ended (plan ended: final filing), new (first Form 5500 filing under this EIN), recordkeeper (401(k)/403(b) recordkeeper changed), advisor (401(k)/403(b) advisor firm changed)

current_plan_year_only.description: Only employers whose latest filing is plan year 2025 or later

include_old.description: Include plans that ended (final filing) and filings for plan years before the last two; left out by default

include_peo.description: Include PEOs (professional employer organizations such as ADP TotalSource or Insperity), which file one plan for many client companies

recordkeeper.description: 401(k)/403(b) recordkeeper (exact or partial), e.g. Fidelity, Empower. From the retirement plan's Schedule C, identified with an AI model

retirement_advisor.description: Advisory or consulting firm paid by the 401(k)/403(b) plan (exact or partial), e.g. CAPTRUST, SageView. Firms only

min_plan_assets.description: Minimum retirement plan net assets in dollars (largest 401(k)/403(b))

max_plan_assets.description: Maximum retirement plan net assets in dollars

include_small_plans.description: Also include about 170,000 small-plan employers (25+ participants) that file only the short Form 5500-SF. They have no carriers, brokers, premium or renewal month; their size and 401(k)/403(b) plan come from the short form

limit.description: Default 25; at most 25 without a key

tools.name: get_employer
tools.description: One employer by EIN: every Schedule A contract (carrier, lines, premium, covered lives, commissions and fees, comp rate, broker), plans with links to the original filing PDFs, and plan-year history back to 2019 (participants, premium, funding, carriers, brokers).

tools.name: get_broker
tools.description: A brokerage firm's book from Form 5500 filings: employers, participants, premium placed, commissions and fees, comp rate, top states and carriers, group sizes, recent broker-of-record changes (groups gained and groups that moved), largest employers. Firms with 5+ employers only; individual agents aren't covered.

name.description: Firm name or page slug, e.g. Lockton or marsh-mclennan-agency

tools.name: get_carrier
tools.description: An insurance carrier's group business from Form 5500 filings: employers, premium, covered lives, lines, top states, brokers placing it, median comp rate, largest employers; plus its fully insured small- and large-group market share, 3-year MLR and rebates owed by state from CMS Medical Loss Ratio data (field mlr). Carriers with 5+ employers.

name.description: Carrier name or slug, e.g. Cigna

tools.name: get_state
tools.description: Employee benefits market in one state: employers, participants, premium, funding mix, top medical carriers, top brokers, renewal months, median comp rate, largest employers; plus fully insured small- and large-group market share, 3-year MLR and rebates owed by carrier from CMS Medical Loss Ratio data (field mlr), which also covers groups too small to file a 5500.

tools.name: get_recordkeeper
tools.description: A 401(k)/403(b) recordkeeper's plans among employers on Open5500: plans, share of plans with a recordkeeper identified, active participants, plan assets, plans by asset size, states, advisor firms on its plans and largest plans. From Schedule C (plans paying providers $5,000+), identified with an AI model. Recordkeepers with 25+ plans.

name.description: Recordkeeper name or slug, e.g. Fidelity, Empower, Principal

tools.name: get_retirement_advisor
tools.description: A 401(k)/403(b) advisory or consulting firm's plans among employers on Open5500 (Schedule C codes 16, 17, 26, 27): plans, active participants, plan assets, plans by size, states, recordkeepers on its plans and largest plans; bd = mostly filed as a broker-dealer platform. Managed-account and fiduciary services offered through recordkeepers are not included. Firms with 25+ plans or a broker page.

name.description: Firm name or slug, e.g. CAPTRUST, SageView Advisory Group, OneDigital

tools.name: get_benchmarks
tools.description: Broker comp-rate benchmarks (median, 25th and 75th percentile of commissions + fees as a share of premium) and median premium per covered life per month, by line of coverage and group size.

line.description: Line of coverage, e.g. Medical, Dental, Life. Omit for all lines.

participants.description: Group size to pick the size band. Omit for all bands.

retirement.description: Instead return 401(k)/403(b) fee benchmarks: administrative expenses paid from plan assets as a share of assets and per active participant, by plan size (fund expenses not included)

plan_assets.description: With retirement: plan assets in dollars to pick the size band
